description: Verify that TCP moves from TIME-WAIT to CLOSED after a 2*MSL timeout, with TIME-WAIT reached through CLOSING (RFC 793 §3.2 p23 Terminology)
approach:
[Objective]
Same as BASICS_11 but TIME-WAIT is reached via CLOSING (simultaneous-close path: both sides FIN at the same time, then exchange ACKs).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. driveCloseToTimeWaitClosing prelude → DUT in TIME-WAIT (via CLOSING).
2. Wait 2*MSL.
3. Tester → DUT: probe segment.
4. Observation: DUT → Tester: RST (CLOSED-state response)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT replies RST to the post-2MSL probe.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack / Fail_no_close_fin / Fail_no_closing_ack — prelude broken
• Fail_no_replay_rst — no RST after 2*MSL via CLOSING

verdicts.Pass: DUT moved TIME-WAIT → CLOSED after 2*MSL (CLOSING) — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_closing_ack: No DUT ACK in CLOSING transition
verdicts.Fail_no_replay_rst: No DUT RST after 2*MSL post TIME-WAIT via CLOSING
